settings.heading: Oak or bamboo
settings.subheading: Same secure hold. Two different materials, for two different priorities.
settings.intro_heading: We started with solid oak. You asked for something more accessible — so we built bamboo alongside it.
settings.intro_text: Both ranges share the exact same engineering: the same secure grip, the same fixing kit, the same no-fall hold. What's different is the material, and what that means for how it looks on your wall.
settings.cta_text: Ask yourself one question: is this mount going to be part of your decor, or just doing a job out of sight? If it's decor, go oak. If it's a job, bamboo will do it just as safely, for less.

settings.heading: Solid oak
settings.text:
Every oak mount starts as a single piece of solid oak, hand-shaped from raw timber in our Gironde workshop. Because it is cut from whole wood rather than assembled from smaller pieces, no two mounts are quite the same — the grain is unique to that one piece of tree, and it only deepens with age.

For the board you actually love: the one that deserves to be looked at, not just stored.

settings.heading: Bamboo
settings.text:
Shaped bamboo, put through the same design and the same fixing process as the oak. A leaner process and a faster cut make it lighter on the wallet, and it does exactly the job you need — off the floor, held safely, no ceremony required.

What it does not try to be is a showpiece. If function comes first, bamboo gets it done, honestly.
